name: Musubi Memory
description: First-class durable Musubi memory provider for OpenClaw: native recall/store tools, verified episodic capture, and operator-visible delivery health.
author: Eric Mey

core.baseUrl.label: Musubi Core URL
core.baseUrl.help: Base URL of your Musubi core service. Plugin talks to this over HTTPS.

core.token.label: Bearer Token
core.token.help: Bearer token issued by Musubi. Scope must include the presence(s) this plugin represents.

core.perAgentTokens.label: Per-Agent Tokens
core.perAgentTokens.help: Map OpenClaw agent ids to dedicated Musubi bearer SecretRefs. Used in per-agent presence mode to keep each agent's identity isolated. Shape: {"aoi": {"source":"exec","provider":"onepassword","id":"musubi-aoi"}}.

presence.defaultId.label: Default Presence
presence.defaultId.help: Presence identifier used when no per-agent presence mapping is provided. Shape: <owner>/<presence>.

presence.perAgent.label: Per-Agent Presence Map
presence.perAgent.help: Map OpenClaw agent ids to Musubi presences. Shape: {"aoi": "eric/aoi", "rin": "eric/rin"}.

supplement.enabled.label: Legacy Supplement Compatibility
supplement.enabled.help: Deprecated compatibility setting retained for configuration migration. First-class Musubi retrieval uses native memory tools.

supplement.planes.label: Supplement Planes
supplement.planes.help: Which Musubi planes contribute to the memory supplement. Default: curated, concept.

supplement.maxResults.label: Supplement Result Cap
supplement.maxResults.help: Max results injected per memory turn. Keep small — prompt budget is limited.

capture.mirrorOpenClawMemory.label: Legacy Capture Alias
capture.mirrorOpenClawMemory.help: Deprecated alias for capture.completedTurns. Retained for one migration release.

capture.completedTurns.label: Capture Completed Turns
capture.completedTurns.help: Durably queue completed OpenClaw turns into Musubi episodic memory.

thoughts.enabled.label: Legacy Thought Delivery
thoughts.enabled.help: Deprecated and inactive in this release. The old inbound SSE consumer had no OpenClaw context-delivery contract and is not registered by the first-class provider.

thoughts.reconnect.maxBackoffMs.label: Legacy Thought Reconnect Max Backoff
thoughts.reconnect.maxBackoffMs.help: Deprecated compatibility setting; inactive in this release.
